data.body: Disposition 2026-11-01: working as designed; closing not_a_bug. Prior intent settles it: docs/plan-review-gate.md (close-time attestation gate) states the close gate exists to catch a plan that changed during execution, enforced by own-material and pin drift, which force a re-review at close. effusive-sportive-sapsucker (closed) AC: 'plan/pin change during execution still invalidates close (material/pin drift), forcing re-review -- unchanged.' unpurified-wolflike-flycatcher (closed) designed re-review as the remedy. For epic e12f itself the operator chose re-review. AC1 (a close path needing no fresh review) contradicts those records, so it is not adopted. Remaining lever is the separately gated verify.completion_floor_active (ADR 0024), which is its own calibration decision.
